id.description: kebab-case unique id; defaults to slug of name

flavor.description: one-line evocative summary of the armor's look/feel/circus theme

category.description: 5e armor category. clothing = baseAC 10-12 + full Dex and needs NO proficiency — it is the FULL CASTERS' lane (Illusionist, Jester), who have no armour proficiency at all. light = the half-casters, the Juggler and the Acrobat. medium = the Joker and the Sandow. heavy and shield = the Sandow alone.

trait.description: One always-on property, the armour equivalent of a weapon's mastery. This is what makes two items with the same AC a real choice — before traits existed, the only levers were AC and a stealth penalty nothing in this game punishes. Definitions live in data/rules/armor-traits.json and ARMOR_TRAITS in app.js. The highest-AC item in each tier deliberately has NO trait: that is the trade.

availability.description: How a character gets it. starter = basic, cheap, available at character creation (padded/leather/studded, hide/scale, chain mail, shield). bought = a premium upgrade acquired later by purchase or loot, NOT owned at creation (breastplate, half-plate, splint, plate). Roughly tracks 5e cost (starter < ~75gp; bought >= ~200gp). Actual price is left to the DM/campaign.

baseAC.description: Base Armor Class before Dexterity, for body armor (light/medium/heavy). Omit for shields (use acBonus instead).

maxDexBonus.description: Dexterity cap added to baseAC. null = no cap (light armor adds full Dex mod); 2 = medium armor; 0 = heavy armor (no Dex). Omit for shields.

acBonus.description: Shields only: the flat AC bonus a shield adds (e.g. 2). Omit for body armor.

strengthRequirement.description: Minimum Strength score to wear without a speed penalty; omit if none. Heavy armors are typically 13-15.

stealthDisadvantage.description: true if wearing this armor imposes disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. Thematic only, and kept for heavy armour where it is obvious — it is NOT a balancing lever, because nothing in this system leans on Stealth hard enough to be worth 1 AC. Differentiate with `trait` instead.
